sources.locator: MARKET.md: exact excerpt in pinned local snapshot
sources.text:
**작동하는 로컬 프로토타입**이다. 제공자별 조건 비교, 자원 사용권, 원자적 예치,
제한된 실제 계산, 독립 결과 검사, 지급·환불과 JSON-LD 영수증을 연결한다.
결제 단위는 `sandbox:SIM-MHC`이며 실제 암호화폐 발행·전송은 하지 않는다.

sources.title: How the ASF works
sources.locator: What is the ASF; Foundation structure
sources.text: Apache describes shared infrastructure and organizational support, with project management committees exercising technical authority.
sources.limitation: Institutional self-description; does not prove this design will work for MetaHumotonic.

sources.title: Our Story
sources.text: Ethereum Foundation says the protocol should not depend on a single organization and describes strengthening ecosystem capacity through independent teams.
sources.limitation: An expressed institutional aim, not an independent decentralization measurement.

sources.title: Relationship between SPI and associated projects
sources.text: SPI describes fiscal support for associated projects while leaving project ownership and governance independent.
sources.limitation: An example of shared administration; does not establish eligibility or a relationship with this project.

sources.title: Associated Project HOWTO
sources.text: SPI describes eligibility for genuine, substantial and significant free and open source projects.
sources.limitation: MHL project eligibility is unverified; no application was made.

sources.title: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
sources.text: The authors identify optimizing a formal reward in unintended ways as an AI safety problem.
sources.limitation: A failure category, not a result from this proposed ecosystem.

sources.title: The Open Source Definition
sources.text: The OSI definition requires distribution terms meeting its criteria; access to source code alone is insufficient.
sources.limitation: A definition, not an OSI review of MHL or a jurisdiction-specific legal opinion.

sources.title: Beyond Markets and States: Polycentric Governance of Complex Economic Systems
sources.locator: Printed pp. 653 and 659; PDF pages 13 and 19 (one-based)
sources.text: Ostrom examines resource boundaries, participant rule making, monitoring, conflict resolution and nested governance, while rejecting automatic success from institutional form alone.
sources.limitation: Human common-resource research, read in an author-paper copy hosted by Portland State University; applying it to AI is an untested analogy. Publisher metadata checked separately; exact publication day unknown.

sources.title: Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol Official Specification v0.3.0
sources.locator: Sections 1–2, 5 and 6: opaque systems, AgentCard, Task, Message and Artifact
sources.text: A2A v0.3.0 describes Agent Cards and stateful tasks for communication among potentially opaque agent systems.
sources.limitation: Communication interoperability does not establish HSWM state portability, result validity or one Task per LLM response. This research pins v0.3.0 without asserting it is the latest release; no adapter is implemented here.

sources.title: ERC-8004: Trustless Agents
sources.text: The ERC-8004 draft separates identity, reputation and validation registries, excludes payments, and acknowledges Sybil and advertised-capability limits.
sources.limitation: Observed draft status is not a final standard or immutable revision. Registration does not prove honest results, governance eligibility or implementation readiness; no chain deployment is claimed.

sources.title: AP2 Agent Authorization Framework
sources.locator: Mandate Structure; Verification and Processing Rules; Action Authorization
sources.text: AP2 describes user-approved mandates bound to transactions, with constraints verified and unknown constraints rejected.
sources.limitation: An unversioned official web observation. User-delegated commerce does not establish human-free sovereignty, compute access, or a replay-safe implementation; integration remains proposed.
